statement: Random-cluster interfaces: critical, disordered, thermal, and natural-time scaling. Proves chordal SLEκ limits for critical square-lattice random-cluster interfaces for $`0\lt q\le4`$, with $`\kappa=4\pi/\arccos(-\sqrt q/2)`$: bounded Jordan domains are allowed for q ≥ 1, and smooth Jordan domains for q < 1, under the stated marked-boundary approximations. For $`1\le q\le4`$, complete nested plane loops converge to CLEκ.
